text: AI is changing the way we think about creativity. Today, AI can generate art, compose music, and even write stories. These tools help people create faster and try new ideas. However, some people ask whether machine creativity is the same as human creativity. AI learns from data and follows patterns, but it does not feel emotions or have personal experiences. Human creativity comes from imagination, feelings, and life experience. In my opinion, AI is a useful tool, but it cannot replace the human touch. The best results may come when people and machines work together.
